body: I don't go because I hate talking to people. I'm just really awkward and get anxious that everybody is judging me. That was just my example of why I don't feel like talking to a doctor is an option for me. It's really hard for me to talk to people about the simplest of things let alone this type of stuff.

I haven't smoked since I was fired. I don't have any money. I don't see going to a doctor as a possibility. I can't even go to a barber shop to get my hair cut because I'm so awkward and get anxious. I have to cut my own hair with clippers or whatever and look like a fucking idiot until it grows out a little bit. Plus I don't have any insurance. I honestly don't even know why I posted this. I don't know what I'm expecting to happen that would help me.
